header: Usage charges on top of the monthly plan
lead: We never charge per patient or per appointment. Everything not listed here is included in the monthly price.
note: Each item appears as its own line on the monthly invoice, with the count for the month. Prices exclude 20% VAT.

rates.title: SMS appointment reminder
rates.text: Per message sent. Failed reminders are not counted.

rates.title: Printed recall letter
rates.text: Per letter, including paper, envelope and postage within Austria.

rates.title: Document storage above 20 GB
rates.text: Per gigabyte per month, measured on the last day of the month.

rates.title: Card-terminal transaction
rates.text: Per completed card payment. The terminal's own bank fees are separate.

rates.title: Additional treatment address
rates.text: Per address per month, counted on the first day of the month.

rates.title: Restore from an archived backup
rates.text: Per restore of a backup older than 90 days. Newer restores are free.
